summary: Completed testing of LLM retry module and regenerate endpoint error handling fix. The fix prevents raw 'litellm.RateLimitError' exceptions from bubbling up to the UI. All module functions work correctly, and error messages are now user-friendly.

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. The llm_retry module is properly integrated into all LLM callsites (ai_studio.py, auto_content.py, path_generator.py). The regenerate endpoint correctly catches exceptions and returns friendly error messages.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend testing not required for this backend-only fix.

passed_tests: llm_retry.is_transient_llm_error() correctly identifies 429 concurrent_request_limit as transient
llm_retry.is_transient_llm_error() correctly identifies rate limit errors as transient
llm_retry.is_transient_llm_error() correctly identifies overloaded_error as transient
llm_retry.is_transient_llm_error() correctly identifies timeout errors as transient
llm_retry.is_transient_llm_error() correctly identifies 502/503/504 as transient
llm_retry.is_transient_llm_error() correctly rejects non-transient errors (NameError, ValueError)
llm_retry.friendly_llm_error() returns clean messages without 'litellm', 'RateLimitError', or 'OpenAIException'
llm_retry.friendly_llm_error() includes friendly language like 'busy', 'wait', 'overloaded'
POST /api/admin/auto/queue/{id}/regenerate returns 404 for non-existent queue items
POST /api/admin/auto/queue/{id}/regenerate returns 400 for invalid status (pending)
GET /api/admin/auto/queue successfully lists all queue items
Admin authentication works correctly
All LLM callsites properly wrapped with llm_call_with_retry (ai_studio._chat_complete, auto_content.grade_draft, path_generator._chat_complete)
Server.py regenerate endpoint imports and uses is_transient_llm_error and friendly_llm_error
Error handling returns 503 for transient errors, 502 for permanent failures
Retry logic: Transient errors succeed on retry (tested with simulated 429 error)
Retry logic: Non-transient errors fail immediately without retry (tested with ValueError)
Retry logic: Transient errors exhaust retries after max_retries attempts (tested with 503)
Retry logic: Backoff schedule works correctly (2s, 5s, 10s, 20s, 30s)
All integration points verified: ai_studio.py, auto_content.py, path_generator.py, server.py

Code review confirming all LLM callsites are wrapped with retry logic
Code review confirming server.py regenerate endpoint catches exceptions and uses friendly_llm_error
Regression tests confirming endpoint behavior for invalid inputs (404, 400)
The implementation follows the exact pattern described in the fix documentation
test_limitations.confidence_level: HIGH - The fix is correctly implemented and all testable components pass. The only untested scenario is the actual LLM failure during regenerate, which would require either: (1) a real rate-limit error from the LLM provider, or (2) manually creating a failed queue item. The code path is correct and will handle errors as designed.
